en.p2_intro: Hi, I'm Yan. I'm 18 and I've been deep in programming since I was 15. Over the last couple of years I've shifted my focus entirely to AI and automation — studying how businesses across Europe are using it to grow without growing their costs. Now I'm launching Aucta AI: a hands-on automation agency. I build and deploy AI workflows that actually work — chatbots, lead pipelines, CRM automation, RAG systems. My first clients get everything built for free. No catch — I need the case studies, you need the automation.

p2_principles.title: Zero disruption to your current setup
p2_principles.desc: I integrate with the tools you already use — CRM, email, messengers. Nothing gets replaced, only enhanced and connected.

p2_principles.title: Results measured in hours and euros
p2_principles.desc: Every automation comes with a before/after estimate: hours per week freed up and what that's worth in actual salary cost.

p3_pains.title: Hours lost to repetitive work
p3_pains.desc: Your team answers the same questions, copies data by hand, sends the same emails. This consumes 30–40% of working time every single day.

p3_pains.title: Leads go cold while you sleep
p3_pains.desc: A lead comes in Friday evening. It gets processed Monday morning. By then they've already signed with a competitor who responded in minutes.

p3_pains.title: Data scattered across tools
p3_pains.desc: CRM, email, WhatsApp, spreadsheets — no one has the full picture. Things get missed. Deals fall through the cracks.

p3_pains.desc: Every time you scale, you need to hire. 100 more clients means more support staff, more managers, more costs. AI automation breaks this pattern.

În ultimii doi ani m-am concentrat complet pe AI și automatizare — studiind cum afacerile din toată Europa folosesc asta pentru a crește fără a-și crește costurile. Acum lansez Aucta AI: o agenție de automatizare practică. Construiesc și implementez fluxuri AI care chiar funcționează — chatboți, pipeline-uri de lead-uri, automatizare CRM, sisteme RAG.
